column1: # Bench panel: Forslund et al. 1999 (doi:10.1099/0022-1317-80-9-2437), FAP59/FAP64.
# The paper tested 75 HPV types and got a band from 65 (abstract, checked 2026-10-19).
# No band: types 1, 2, 35, 41, 44, 55, 63, 66, 71, 74 (read from the paper's results
# in the 2026-10-19 session; PDF not in papers/, so not re-read since).
# One genome per type: RefSeq where one exists, else the newest GenBank complete
# genome with that type in its organism name. Forslund used cloned prototypes, so
# an isolate here can differ from the clone at a primer site.
